program:
def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    van_patches = image_patch.find("silver van")
    if not van_patches: return image_patch
    
    left_vans = [v for v in van_patches if v.left < image_patch.width / 2]
    right_vans = [v for v in van_patches if v.right > image_patch.width / 2]
    
    return left_vans + right_vans
